Hero.subtitle: High-Performance Heavy Machinery
Hero.description: We distribute top-quality heavy and yellow machinery: excavators, bulldozers, motor graders and more. Complete technical support and coverage throughout Latin America.

About.subtitle: Who We Are
About.p1: At MAQUIPRO we are specialists in the commercialization and distribution of yellow and heavy machinery from the world's leading brands. With over 15 years of experience in the sector, we have consolidated our presence throughout Latin America.
About.p2: We offer excavation, earthmoving, compaction and transport equipment, backed by a highly trained technical team that guarantees optimal performance of each unit.
About.p3: Our priority is to provide comprehensive solutions: from selecting the ideal equipment for your project to post-sale support and the supply of genuine spare parts.

Machinery.subtitle: Equipment Catalog
Machinery.machine1_desc: High-performance crawler excavators for mining, construction and civil works. Long-reach booms available.
Machinery.machine2_desc: High-power bulldozers for massive material pushing, land leveling and large-scale works.
Machinery.machine3_desc: Precision grading for road construction, platforms and slopes. GPS system available.
Machinery.machine4_desc: Wheel loaders for efficient loose material handling in quarries, ports and processing plants.
Machinery.machine5_desc: Compaction rollers for road bases, asphalt and fills. High centrifugal force for maximum density.
Machinery.machine6_desc: High-capacity cranes for lifting in construction, oil industry and infrastructure projects.

ValueProps.subtitle: Why Choose Us
ValueProps.pillar1_desc: Presence in 18 Latin American countries with a network of authorized distributors and workshops ready to serve you.
ValueProps.pillar2_desc: Our engineering team helps you select the ideal equipment for your project, avoiding cost overruns and mistakes.
ValueProps.pillar3_desc: All our equipment comes with factory warranty and international certification. No compromises on quality.
ValueProps.pillar4_desc: Technical assistance center available 24 hours, 7 days a week to minimize downtime.
ValueProps.pillar5_desc: Extensive stock available for immediate delivery. Specialized logistics for heavy equipment throughout the territory.
ValueProps.cta_desc: Speak with our advisors and receive a personalized quote in less than 24 hours.

Contact.description: Tell us about your project and we will advise you on the most suitable equipment. Guaranteed response within 24 business hours.

EducationCenter.meta_title: QSP Education Center - Heavy Machinery Training
EducationCenter.meta_desc: Specialized training in heavy machinery operation and maintenance. 3D simulators, certified instructors, and locations throughout Latin America.
EducationCenter.hero_desc: Comprehensive training in heavy machinery operation, maintenance and safety. Cutting-edge 3D simulators, certified instructors, and internationally valid certifications.
EducationCenter.prog1_desc: 40-hour introductory course for beginner operators. Includes safety fundamentals, basic controls and 3D simulation.
EducationCenter.prog2_desc: 80-hour intensive program with advanced operation techniques, preventive maintenance and certification on specific equipment.
EducationCenter.prog3_desc: 120-hour technical course focused on diagnosis, repair and maintenance of hydraulic systems, engine and transmission.
EducationCenter.prog4_desc: Training in ISO safety standards, risk management and emergency procedures in heavy machinery operations.
EducationCenter.3d_desc: Our 3D simulators faithfully reproduce the operating environment of each machine, providing an immersive and safe learning experience. Practice complex maneuvers without risks or equipment wear.
EducationCenter.map_desc: We have strategically located training centers to provide coverage throughout Latin America.
